name: System
description: Macro bot with an in-game menu: record and replay inputs frame by frame.

menu-key.name: Menu key
menu-key.description: Key that opens and closes the System menu.

hotkeys.name: F1-F5 hotkeys
hotkeys.description: F1 record, F2 replay, F3 stop, F4 save, F5 load (works inside a level).

tps.name: TPS
tps.description: Fixed physics steps per second used while recording/replaying.
